{{translated title}} ---- (Japanese: '''{{j|ポケモンカードゲームやろうぜ～っ！　ソード{{ruby|＆|アンド}}シールド{{ruby|編|へん}}}}''' ''Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game! Sword & Shield Arc'') is a {{pkmn|manga}} by [[Ryū Matsushima]] based on the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]]. It was serialized in the ''[[CoroCoro|CoroCoro Ichiban!]]'' magazine from the February 2020 issue (released on December 21, 2019) to the February 2023 issue (released on December 21, 2022). It is the sequel of [[Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game! Sun & Moon Arc]] and is followed by [[Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game! Scarlet & Violet Arc]]. It tells the story of '''Kenma Ibuki''' (Japanese: '''{{j|{{ruby|伊|い}}{{ruby|吹|ぶき}}ケンマ}}''' ''Ibuki Kenma''). Like its predecessor, this manga was collected into four volumes that are simply referred to as (Japanese: '''{{j|ポケモンカードゲームやろうぜ～っ！}}''' ''Let's Play the Pokémon Card Game!''). Instead of being labeled numerically, they are individually titled (Japanese: '''{{j|ソード{{ruby|＆|アンド}}シールド　スタート！{{ruby|編|へん}}}}''' ''Sword & Shield Start! Arc''), (Japanese: '''{{j|「いちげき」{{ruby|ｖｓ|バーサス}}「れんげき」{{ruby|編|へん}}}}''' ''Single Strike vs Rapid Strike Arc''), (Japanese: '''{{j|ポケモン{{ruby|Ｖ|ブイ}}{{ruby|ＳＴＡＲ|スター}}{{ruby|攻|こう}}{{ruby|略|りゃく}}！{{ruby|編|へん}}}}''' ''Pokémon VSTAR Strategy! Arc''), and (Japanese: '''{{j|{{ruby|Ｖ|ブイ}}{{ruby|ＳＴＡＲ|スター}}！{{ruby|Ｖ|ブイ}}{{ruby|ＭＡＸ|マックス}}！{{ruby|激|げき}}{{ruby|闘|とう}}{{ruby|編|へん}}}}''' ''VSTAR! VMAX! Fierce Duel Arc'').
